gloss: place to escape to; way out; refuge

definitions.gloss: place to escape to; way out; refuge
definitions.explanation: A place one can flee to, physically or emotionally; a way out of a pressing situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれて→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧{逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Surrounded by fire, they lost any way of escape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{居場所|いばしょ}→居場所：12366_ibasho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: A community drop-in space was set up for children who have nowhere to escape to at school or at home.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no escape
- {逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to be cornered
- {逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to give someone (or oneself) a way out
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逃|に}げ{場|ば}: an emotional refuge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逃|に}げ{道|みち}→逃げ道：27610_nigemichi⟧: escape route; often a loophole or excuse
- {逃|に}げ{場|ば} is the place itself, and is common in talk about stress and mental health
